title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Endicott study settings, from flexible library seating and computer workstations to specialized lounges and residence-hall study nooks.

cards.entity_name: Diane M. Halle Library Main Area
cards.title: Set Up Around a Movable Library Table
cards.subtitle: Flexible seating, public computers, printers, and campus views
cards.notes: Choose a modular table for spread-out work, or use a public computer; bring a payment method if you plan to print.
cards.short_summary: A flexible central-library workspace suited to laptop sessions, research, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says Halle Library's main area has public computer stations and pay-per-print printers; its refreshed seating includes soft chairs and modular movable tables.
cards.access_notes: Computer-lab support is available during the day; consult current library notices for building access and holiday or vacation schedules.

cards.title: Take the Work Upstairs
cards.subtitle: A distinct mezzanine option inside Halle Library
cards.notes: Head to the mezzanine when you want separation from the entrance; choose seating that matches reading or laptop work.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level library setting with its own mix of study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott's account of the library refresh identifies the mezzanine as a study location and says seating throughout the library includes soft seating and tables of different sizes.
cards.source_title: A Refreshed Halle Library Invites Students to Study, Read, and Relax | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Located inside Halle Library; check current library access information before relying on the space during breaks or holidays.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Computer Stop
cards.subtitle: Always-open access during ordinary campus operations
cards.notes: Bring your Gull Card and use the public workstations for a late or early computer session; budget separately for printing.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock campus computer area for work outside standard lab hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott states that the Cyber Cafe has public computer stations and pay-per-print printers and is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Endicott currently lists the Cyber Cafe as open 24/7; campus identification or building-access controls may apply.

cards.entity_name: Tutoring & Writing Center, Halle Library Room 204
cards.title: Pair the Workspace With a Tutoring Session
cards.subtitle: Appointment-linked study support in Halle Library Room 204
cards.notes: Book online, then arrive with a clear goal and the course materials you need; the room is not open for unscheduled study.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative academic-support space reserved for students attending tutoring sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott locates the Tutoring & Writing Center in Halle Library Room 204 and says only students whose tutoring sessions are occurring may work in the space.
cards.source_title: About the Endicott Tutoring & Writing Center | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: An appointment is required to use the room; sessions are available to Endicott students in person or remotely.

cards.title: Study Between Classes in Lower Callahan
cards.subtitle: A designated lounge for commuters and veterans
cards.notes: Use the lounge between classes for a focused work block, and check posted programming before planning a longer session.
cards.short_summary: A constituency-specific Callahan Center lounge explicitly intended for studying or downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies the Commuter & Veterans Lounge in Lower Callahan as a place for veterans and commuters to study or spend time between classes.
cards.access_notes: Intended for Endicott commuters and veterans. The Callahan Center is open to students 24/7 during the academic year.

cards.title: Find a Study Setup on the Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Multiple study spaces inside the Cummings School
cards.notes: Go to the third-floor entrance area and choose among the lounge's study setups; yield specialized space to program users.
cards.short_summary: A modern academic-building lounge with several documented configurations for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says the Sport Science Lounge is situated at the third-floor entrance of the Cummings School building and features a variety of study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of an academic facility; use is subject to current building access and scheduled academic activity.

cards.title: Bring a Laptop to the Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: A technology-oriented workspace in the business and science complex
cards.notes: Choose this lounge for laptop work near STEM resources; confirm whether nearby labs require a class, booking, or supervision.
cards.short_summary: A named tech lounge located among the complex's computer and collaborative-learning facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott lists a student tech lounge inside the Gerrish Business/Judge Science Center alongside a STEM PC lab and team-building classrooms.
cards.access_notes: Use the lounge during current academic-building access periods; nearby specialized labs may have separate restrictions.

cards.title: Work Between Arts Classes and Rehearsals
cards.subtitle: Student lounge space overlooking the main-campus ponds
cards.notes: Bring quiet, portable work and choose the lounge between arts commitments; check whether a reception affects availability.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge inside Endicott's visual and performing arts facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott documents student and faculty lounges in the Manninen Center, with facilities that can also support public receptions.
cards.source_title: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Lounge access follows Manninen Center building access and may be affected by classes, performances, or public receptions.

cards.title: Use a Residential Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Study nooks paired with spacious floor lounges
cards.notes: If you live in Marblehead Hall, take compact work to a study nook and keep the adjacent shared lounge clear for residents.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated study nooks embedded in a four-story residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says Marblehead Hall includes spacious lounges, kitchenettes on every floor, and study nooks.
cards.source_title: Housing Options | Residence Halls & Houses | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: This is residential space; access is limited by Endicott's residence-hall entry and guest policies.

cards.title: Settle Into a Stoneridge Nook
cards.subtitle: Small study areas near lounges and floor kitchenettes
cards.notes: Residents can bring a short assignment to a nook, using the nearby kitchenette or lounge without occupying a bedroom desk.
cards.short_summary: A second residence-hall option with purpose-identified nooks for individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says Stoneridge Hall includes spacious lounges, kitchenettes on every floor, and study nooks.
cards.source_title: Housing Options | Residence Halls & Houses | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: This is residential space; access is limited by Endicott's residence-hall entry and guest policies.

warnings: Exact coordinates for interior spaces were not published on the supporting pages, so latitude and longitude are null.
The campus-map URL identifies the parent destinations but does not provide stable direct URLs for each interior study space.
Residence-hall study nooks are subject to residential access controls; the Tutoring & Writing Center requires an active tutoring session.
